article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Autoflowering hybrid
Genetics: GG4 Auto F6 × Strawberry Pie Auto F5
Breeder: Fast Buds
THC Content: 28.4%
CBD Content: Less than 1%
Terpene Profile: limonene , myrcene , beta-caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Strawberry candy, ripe berries, tropical fruit
Flowering Time (Indoor): 10 weeks from seed to harvest
Outdoor Harvest Time: 10 weeks from seed to harvest
Indoor Yield: 450–600 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 60–300 g per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Strawberry Gorilla Auto demonstrates how far autoflowering marijuana genetics have progressed beyond the small, low-potency plants once associated with ruderalis breeding. Fast Buds developed this F5 autoflower by combining advanced GG4 Auto and Strawberry Pie Auto lines, then selecting for the traits normally expected from premium photoperiod cannabis: large plants, exceptionally resinous flowers, loud terpenes, substantial yield, and potency approaching 30% total cannabinoids .

The finished flower smells less like a subtle strawberry field than a strawberry candy soaked in fuel, with ripe berries, tropical sweetness, cream, and diesel competing for attention. More significantly, this cultivar has competition credentials to support its reputation. It won first place at the inaugural American Autoflower Cup in Los Angeles in 2023 and later earned the Highest Combined Terpenes title in the Home Grow Hash category at the Farmer’s Cup. Fast Buds lists the plant as 55% sativa and 45% indica, producing an uplifting cerebral beginning followed by a calmer physical finish.
Genetics and Lineage

Fast Buds officially identifies Strawberry Gorilla Auto as GG4 Auto F6 × Strawberry Pie Auto F5. This is a relatively advanced autoflower cross rather than a simple first-generation conversion of photoperiod genetics. Both parental lines had already undergone several generations of selection before being combined, and the resulting Strawberry Gorilla Auto was developed as an F5 feminized polyhybrid autoflower. That extended breeding work helps explain why the cultivar can express large plants, dense flowers, strong potency, and a relatively consistent ten-week life cycle.

The GG4 Auto side provides much of the physical power behind the hybrid. Its background ultimately connects to Gorilla Glue genetics involving Sour Dubb, Chocolate Diesel, and Chem Sis, bringing resin production, fuel, earth, potency, and vigorous growth. Strawberry Pie Auto contributes the sweeter half of the profile, drawing on fruit-heavy genetics that include Strawberry Banana , Tangie , and Blueberry influences. Together, the parents create a cannabis plant that can smell intensely sweet without losing the chemical gas characteristic of the Gorilla family.

The slight sativa dominance is visible both in plant structure and effects. Fast Buds lists the finished genetics at 55% sativa and 45% indica, an unusually balanced profile for an autoflower capable of such high cannabinoid levels. Rather than emphasizing either extreme, the breeding combines upward vigor and cerebral effects with the thicker flower structure and body relaxation associated with its heavier genetic side.
Effects and Experience

The experience usually opens in the head. Strawberry Gorilla Auto can create a rapid lift in mood accompanied by increased interest in conversation, music, creative activities, or whatever is happening nearby. Mental energy can feel bright without becoming relentlessly stimulating, and moderate consumption may preserve enough clarity for daytime or afternoon use. Fast Buds describes the early phase as uplifting and creative before stronger relaxation begins developing through the body.

As the high settles, the indica side becomes easier to recognize. Physical tension can soften while the initial cerebral rush becomes smoother and less urgent. The transition generally stops short of immediate couch-lock at moderate doses, giving this weed a broader useful window than strongly sedating autoflowers. More generous consumption changes that balance, however, and the body effect can become considerably heavier as THC intake rises.

Potency is one of the defining characteristics. Fast Buds lists THC at up to approximately 28.4%, while breeder material notes total cannabinoids reaching 29.86%. Those figures place Strawberry Gorilla Auto among the stronger autoflowering cannabis cultivars available. Consumers with limited tolerance should approach it accordingly. Excessive intake may produce dry mouth, dizziness, anxiety, rapid thoughts, or uncomfortable impairment even though the sweet strawberry flavor can make the smoke seem deceptively approachable.
Medical Benefits

Medical marijuana consumers may be interested in the cultivar when they want both mental elevation and physical relaxation from the same flower. The brighter early stage may temporarily help some consumers move away from everyday stress, low mood, or mental fatigue, while the later body component can become more useful when muscular tension or difficulty relaxing is the larger concern. Unlike cannabis that moves directly into sedation, Strawberry Gorilla Auto generally provides a more gradual transition.

The relatively strong appetite response associated with some examples may also interest patients who use cannabis around meals, while the calming second half can make evening use practical. Effects remain strongly dose-dependent; smaller amounts may feel energetic and sociable, while larger doses can move the experience toward heavy relaxation.

None of those potential uses make this cannabis strain a proven treatment for anxiety, depression, pain, appetite disorders, or another medical condition. High-THC flower can also worsen anxiety in susceptible people. Medical consumers should pay attention to the cannabinoid analysis of the actual harvest, their tolerance, medications, method of consumption, and appropriate healthcare guidance rather than treating the strain name as a standardized medicine.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Strawberry is unmistakably the center of the aromatic profile. Fast Buds describes the flavor as a combination of strawberry candy and berry diesel, an unusually accurate shorthand for the cultivar. Fresh flowers can release a concentrated scent resembling ripe strawberries or red fruit candy before a much heavier gasoline note rises underneath. Creamy fruit and tropical sweetness occupy the middle, while the Gorilla side contributes earth and pungent fuel.

The flavor tends to change as the smoke or vapor develops. Strawberry sweetness leads the inhale, sometimes accompanied by berry syrup or tropical fruit. Creamier notes emerge through the middle before diesel and gas dominate the finish. Some plants show additional pine or citrus, giving the sweetness a sharper edge rather than allowing it to become syrupy.

Its terpene production is an important part of the strain’s reputation. Strawberry Gorilla Auto earned the Highest Combined Terpenes title in the Home Grow Hash category at the 2023 Farmer’s Cup, evidence that the cultivar’s aromatic intensity is not simply descriptive marketing. Exact terpene ratios vary with phenotype and cultivation conditions, but limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene are frequently associated with the line. Proper drying and curing are especially important because fast or excessively warm drying can flatten the volatile strawberry notes that make the flower distinctive.
Growing Information

Autoflowering does not mean miniature in this case. Fast Buds classifies Strawberry Gorilla Auto as an XXL plant and lists heights around 110–120 cm in its current technical specifications, while breeder descriptions note that vigorous examples may approach 150 cm. Plants develop thick branches, a pronounced main cola, and numerous heavy side flowers covered in dense trichomes.

The complete life cycle is approximately ten weeks from seed, eliminating the need to change the lighting schedule to trigger flowering. Indoor yields are listed at approximately 450–600 g/m², while outdoor plants can produce around 60–300 g each under favorable conditions. Unlike photoperiod weed, outdoor harvest does not need to wait for autumn. A plant started during favorable spring or summer weather can finish roughly ten weeks later because flowering is controlled primarily by age rather than shortening daylight.

Its rapid schedule makes early mistakes more difficult to correct. Autoflowers have limited time to recover from transplant stress, severe pruning, nutrient problems, or overly aggressive high-stress training. Gentle low-stress training during early development can spread the branches and improve light penetration without significantly delaying growth. Once flowering accelerates, maintaining stable nutrition, strong lighting, airflow, and root-zone conditions is generally more valuable than repeatedly reshaping the plant.

Heavy resin production makes the cultivar particularly interesting for hash growers. The same characteristic that helped it win a terpene-focused Farmer’s Cup category creates exceptionally sticky flowers near maturity. Growers should maintain appropriate humidity and good air movement around the dense buds, especially during the final weeks when weight and trichome coverage increase rapidly.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Strawberry Gorilla Auto?

Strawberry Gorilla Auto was bred by Fast Buds from GG4 Auto F6 × Strawberry Pie Auto F5. The finished cultivar is an F5 feminized polyhybrid autoflower with approximately 55% sativa and 45% indica genetics.
How strong is Strawberry Gorilla Auto?

Fast Buds lists THC at up to approximately 28.4%, while breeder-tested material has reached 29.86% total cannabinoids. This makes it unusually potent for an autoflower and better suited to experienced cannabis consumers than people with very low THC tolerance.
How long does Strawberry Gorilla Auto take to grow?
The complete cycle is approximately ten weeks from seed to harvest. Because it is an autoflower, growers do not need to switch to a 12/12 lighting schedule to initiate flowering.
What does Strawberry Gorilla Auto taste like?

The dominant flavor is sweet strawberry candy mixed with ripe berries and diesel. Tropical fruit, cream, earth, and gas may appear behind the strawberry, with the fuel character becoming stronger on the exhale.
How much does Strawberry Gorilla Auto yield?

Fast Buds lists approximately 450–600 g/m² indoors and 60–300 g per plant outdoors. Actual production depends on lighting, container size, root health, nutrition, environment, and how smoothly the plant progresses through its short autoflower life cycle.
Final Thoughts on Strawberry Gorilla Auto

Strawberry Gorilla Auto is one of the clearest examples of why modern autoflower genetics deserve to be evaluated separately from their early reputation. Fast Buds combined advanced GG4 Auto and Strawberry Pie Auto lines into a cultivar capable of producing large plants, dense resin-coated flowers, strong yields, and cannabinoid levels approaching 30%. Its ten-week seed-to-harvest schedule accomplishes that without requiring photoperiod manipulation.

Competition results make the genetics even more noteworthy. First place at the 2023 American Autoflower Cup established its overall quality, while the Highest Combined Terpenes award at the Farmer’s Cup highlighted the aromatic intensity that defines the flower. For consumers, the attraction is a vivid combination of strawberry candy, berry fruit, cream, and diesel followed by an effect that progresses from cerebral energy into relaxed physical comfort. For growers, the plant offers something that once seemed unlikely from autoflowering marijuana: photoperiod-level potency and resin production delivered on a roughly seventy-day clock.
